On an ordinary continuous Monday chart the preceding 0859 bar is already Monday, so this condition does not implement a robust weekly reset. Use explicit calendar/week identity in a corrected version, and preserve the source behavior as a discrepancy.

Pre-market stats L789–868 records first hits from cumulative extrema using time_since_start based on chart-bar open timestamps. Such times are interval-localized observations, not exact tick first-passage timestamps, and need bar availability/coverage metadata.

A live numerator can therefore include an unfinished session absent from its denominator, and a zero denominator is displayed as0 rather than unavailable. Session Range Candles L930–953/1091–1146 divides wick-and-close outcomes by all bullish/bearish London sessions in the matched regime. These are joint event frequencies within that cohort, not conditional close probabilities given a wick. London doji enters the else/bear category; strict versus inclusive equality must be explicit.
